findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: webaz_notifications, webaz_skill_library, webaz_connection_status, webaz_address, webaz_order_chat_edit, webaz_order_chat_recall, webaz_cart_view · Private data: webaz_demand, webaz_pay_order, webaz_buy, webaz_register, webaz_place_order, webaz_connection_status, webaz_buyer_orders, webaz_submit_order_request, webaz_address, webaz_order_chat, webaz_order_chat_edit, webaz_order_chat_recall, webaz_request_x402_payment, webaz_wallet_view · Public sink: webaz_demand, webaz_buy, webaz_register, webaz_connection_status, webaz_submit_order_request, webaz_prepare_case, webaz_approval_requests, webaz_buyer_action_request, webaz_address · Destructive: webaz_cart_view.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: webaz_notifications, webaz_skill_library, webaz_connection_status, webaz_address, webaz_order_chat_edit, webaz_order_chat_recall, webaz_cart_view · Private data: webaz_demand, webaz_pay_order, webaz_buy, webaz_register, webaz_place_order, webaz_connection_status, webaz_buyer_orders, webaz_submit_order_request, webaz_address, webaz_order_chat, webaz_order_chat_edit, webaz_order_chat_recall, webaz_request_x402_payment, webaz_wallet_view · Public sink: webaz_demand, webaz_buy, webaz_register, webaz_connection_status, webaz_submit_order_request, webaz_prepare_case, webaz_approval_requests, webaz_buyer_action_request, webaz_address · Destructive: webaz_cart_view

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
